explanation: The proof builds on TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis (Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/SheafCondition/Sites.lean). That lemma states that a sheaf morphism is an isomorphism if it is an isomorphism on each basis open. It does not give the scheme-level statement that p.app U is an isomorphism for every open U. Getting there needs the sheaf morphism built from p.c, plus forgetting and evaluating at U, which is more than two short lines. I grepped Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for IsBasis and for isIso_app_of_isBasis and found no matching declaration.
